description: NaN₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. Na is bonded to six N atoms to form edge-sharing NaN₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.58 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded to three equivalent Na and one N atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NNa₃N trigonal pyramids. The N-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. The N-N bond length is 1.19 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded to three equivalent Na and one N atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NNa₃N tetrahedra.
